answer: Auction a fixed number of participation slots each epoch: every identity bids a refundable bond, and only the top bidders act. A sparrow newcomer can still win one slot cheaply when few bid, but a sybil farmer must outbid its own clones, pushing the clearing price up with each extra identity, while the juniper-slow bond stays locked until a random audit clears the work. Slots in the shared garden are scarce by design, so cloning multiplies cost instead of multiplying reward, and failed audits forfeit the bond.
